candidates.summary: The Recently updated front shelf windows apps.updated, which holds address-namespace apps, so a free g1… app gets a front-page card by changing its tagline once updateCooldown has passed
candidates.failure_scenario: Deploy as above, wait 7 epochs, then Register again with a new tagline (or SubmitRich). touch moves the app into apps.updated, listShelf(mustList("updated", h)) takes its first 16, and the app is the first slug of Recently updated in api/v1/home and in the markdown front. The ADR's "Updated cannot be farmed" holds per listing, not per key: keys are free and each namespace takes 5 listings, so staggered listings each refreshed once a week keep the 8 cards gnoweb draws. That is the front-page slot newApps and rotation filter out through namedApps.
